extra.message: Server-Side Template Injection via unsanitized username parameter — Full remote code execution on the server via Jinja2 sandbox escape, allowing arbitrary command execution, filesystem access, and complete compromise of the host running the application. [verified: username is directly concatenated into the Jinja2 template source at line 14 and compiled/rendered with a plain (non-sandboxed) Environment, with no validation or escaping in between, allowing classic SSTI-to-RCE payloads.]
